svg.title: Checking an appealing school announcement
svg.desc: Notice a bias: A hoped-for delay makes pupils less likely to check the message.. Find evidence: Consult the official channel and a responsible person.. Review the system: Families and staff can design reliable ways to issue corrections.

g.text: A hoped-for delay makes pupils less likely to check the message.
Consult the official channel and a responsible person.
Families and staff can design reliable ways to issue corrections.
